metadata.description: warmline makes Claude Code's prompt-cache state visible. This marketplace carries the Desktop band, the gauge as a Claude Code plugin for the Desktop app's Code tab. The statusline, the auditor and the keep-warm policy install with install.sh or Homebrew: https://github.com/Miguel-Barroso/claude-warmline

plugins.name: warmline
plugins.description: Claude Code's prompt-cache state, drawn above the prompt where no statusline renders: the Desktop app's Code tab. Each response graded as `warmline audit` grades it, from its real cache-read and cache-write counts.
